# .NET MAUI

- MAU-009: In MAUI XAML, don't use bindings for content that can easily be set statically, and don't reproduce a layout's appearance with combinations of other layouts. Images should only be created when required and should be released as soon as the app no longer requires them.
- MAU-010: In a MAUI layout, ScrollView objects should not be nested, and should not be nested with other controls that provide scrolling, such as CollectionView, ListView and WebView. Avoid using the AbsoluteLayout.AutoSize property whenever possible, as it makes the layout engine perform additional layout calculations. Bindable layouts should only be used when the collection of items to be displayed is small, and scrolling and selection aren't required.
